name: animId
meaning: animation id of the Robot state (g_robotStateTable 0x57a880, 4 bytes per state: lea [4*state+0x57a880] at 0x45e641, 0x45f796, 0x4618ec); Robot_SetState 0x46191e mov dx,word [ecx] passes it to Anim_Start

name: flags
meaning: RobotStateFlags, read as movzx word [desc+2]: Robot_EnterState 0x461664 &1, SetState 0x461900 &4, Update 0x45f844 &8 (controllable), ScanContextActions 0x45ebde &0x10, UpdateCamera 0x45e7ff &0x20, Update 0x4607d0 &0x40 (dash smoke), Move 0x45ef45 &0x80, UpdateCamera 0x45e723 &0x100
